name: Brass Rebreather
description: A hand-tooled brass mask that recycles breath for up to two hours.

magicalProperties.name: Rebreather
magicalProperties.description: Breathe underwater for 2 hours; DC 12 Con if used longer.

flavor: Smells like warm pennies and old rain.
designNotes: Core dive gear; Trident sells upgrades.

name: Harpoon Rig
description: A wrist-mounted harpoon launcher with a coiled cable.

magicalProperties.name: Retrieve
magicalProperties.description: Bonus action: reel in the harpoon and any Medium or smaller target hooked on it.

name: Glowing Data Core
description: A humming crystal cylinder holding a dead company's records.

magicalProperties.name: Query
magicalProperties.description: Once per dawn, ask the core one question about the Sprawl before the flood.

designNotes: Plot item for the Watching Eye.

name: Storm Lantern
description: A dented lantern whose glass is sealed with wax.

magicalProperties.name: Storm-proof
magicalProperties.description: Burns in wind and underwater for 8 hours.

flavor: Never goes out, even when you want it to.

name: Pressure Satchel
description: A waterproof satchel that holds twice what it should.

magicalProperties.name: Pressure Seal
magicalProperties.description: Items inside are immune to water and pressure damage.

name: Sonar Pistol
description: A pistol that fires pulses of sound.

magicalProperties.name: Sonar Pulse
magicalProperties.description: Action: reveal creatures within 60 ft. until the end of your next turn.

flavor: The ping hums in your teeth.

name: Relic Idol
description: A rusted idol dug from the Drowned Cathedral, warm to the touch.

magicalProperties.name: Murmur
magicalProperties.description: Once per dawn, hear a whisper from the Choir within 1 mile.

name: Live Cable Coil
description: A coil of insulated cable, still humming.

magicalProperties.name: Jolt
magicalProperties.description: Action: 3d6 lightning to a target within 10 ft., DC 13 Dex half.
